Neighbourhood keeps everyday community conversations and practical safety tools in the same clean, familiar place.

💬

Neighbourhood chat

Ask a question, share an update or simply say hello to the people living nearby.

🚨

SOS community alerts

Quickly notify nearby users when something important is happening and local awareness matters.

Safety Activity

See recent safety-related updates, responses and check-ins without digging through the app.

📍

Check-In

Stay informed about conversations and alerts without needing to constantly check the app.

Households & groups

Keep the right people together with local groups built around the places and people that matter to you.

Help support Neighbourhood

Neighbourhood is free to use. Optional contributions help cover hosting, notifications and continued development.

Support the project

Community support, not emergency response

Neighbourhood’s SOS feature helps alert nearby users, but it does not contact or replace emergency services. In an emergency, call 000 in Australia or your local emergency number.
